title: Cross-Subject Priors for Maximum a Posteriori Estimation of Latent Structure Influence Models in Motor-Imagery EEG With Few Trials
abstract: arXiv:2611.20164v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coupled hidden Markov models such as the latent structure influence model (LSIM) describe how the sensorimotor rhythms of the two hemispheres evolve and interact during motor imagery, but subject-specific maximum likelihood (ML) estimates are unstable when few trials are available. This paper derives a maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimator for the LSIM whose conjugate prior equals the expected statistics of $\lambda$ pseudo-trials from a population model fitted to other subjects. The M-step remains in closed form, expectation maximization keeps its monotone ascent, and ML ($\lambda=0$) and the population model ($\lambda\to\infty$) are limiting cases. The prior strength was selected on 35 subjects of the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset and applied unchanged to 70 held-out subjects and to BCI Competition IV-2a. translated_title: 面向少试次运动想象脑电的潜在结构影响模型最大后验估计的跨被试先验方法
translated_abstract: 耦合隐马尔可夫模型（如潜在结构影响模型，LSIM）能够描述运动想象过程中两个大脑半球的感觉运动节律如何演化并相互作用，但当可用试次较少时，针对单个被试的最大似然（ML）估计是不稳定的。本文推导了LSIM的最大后验（MAP）估计器，其共轭先验等于基于其他被试拟合的群体模型所生成的λ个伪试次的期望统计量。该方法的M步仍保持闭式解，期望最大化算法保持单调上升特性，且ML估计（λ=0）和群体模型（λ→∞）是其两个极限情形。先验强度在PhysioNet脑电运动/想象数据集的35名被试上进行选择，并原封不动地应用于70名留出被试以及BCI Competition IV-2a数据集。当λ=1时，留出被试的对数似然在70名被试中有61名超过了ML估计（经Holm校正p=9.1×10^……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出以跨被试群体模型的期望统计量作为共轭先验的LSIM最大后验估计方法，在少试次运动想象脑电中保持闭式M步与单调收敛，并显著优于传统的最大似然估计。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a maximum a posteriori estimator for latent structure influence models in few-trial motor-imagery EEG, using conjugate priors built from cross-subject population-model statistics, which preserves the closed-form M-step and monotone EM convergence while outperforming maximum likelihood in held-out subjects.
